steps.js: const { S } = app, V = app.camera.position.constructor, M4 = app.camera.matrix.constructor; S.parts.forEach((p) => (p.seeds = [])); app.afterEdit(''); const b = S.G.bbox, C = new V((b[0]+b[3])/2, (b[1]+b[4])/2, (b[2]+b[5])/2); const about = (J, n, a) => new M4().makeTranslation(J.x, J.y, J.z).multiply(new M4().makeRotationAxis(n, a)).multiply(new M4().makeTranslation(-J.x, -J.y, -J.z)); const hj = app.jointFrame(4), aj = app.jointFrame(3), bj = app.jointFrame(7); window.__icon = { explode(t) { for (let i = 1; i < S.parts.length; i++) { const x = app.ensureXf(i); x.t = x.c.map((v, k) => +((v - C.getComponent(k)) * (k < 2 ? 0.45 : 0.18) * t).toFixed(4)); } app.applyXf(); }, spin(t) { app.setXfMatrix(4, about(hj.J, hj.n, 2 * Math.PI * t)); app.xfEdited(4); app.applyXf(); }, swing(t) { const n = bj.J.clone().sub(aj.J).normalize(); app.setXfMatrix(3, about(aj.J, n, 35 * Math.PI / 180 * t)); app.xfEdited(3); app.applyXf(); }, };
